candidate.hypothesis: Buried faults with no catalogue trace produce clusters of structural-index-1 Euler solutions at 0.4-6 km depth in the TMI field (band 14).
candidate.mechanism: FFT horizontal and vertical derivatives of TMI; least-squares Euler N=1 in 21-px windows every 4 px; keep depth 0.4-6 km, source in-window, relative residual <= 0.10; 2-px Gaussian density; percentile rank; shared dot placement (30k budget, 200 m catalogue collar).
candidate.named_non_fault_mimic: Magnetic dikes and mafic intrusions also give N~1 solutions (Reid et al. 1990; Reid & Thurston 2014, cited in knowledge/10); near-surface magnetic noise at short wavelengths.
